statement: Synthetic caps are enforced in SimBudgetProfileTest and SimBudgetTelemetry: stage work above the cap is a violation, equality passes, missing residency samples remain unevaluated, and synthetic smoke artifacts fail on a stage violation. Performance CI captures shipping simulation defaults on populated default/mountains/archipelago worlds with seed 1337, 600 ticks, surface radius 1 and collision radius 1, then runs check_sim_budgets.py with --require-complete against the committed baseline. Each preset has nonnegative integer max_work_per_tick limits for all 30 stages and the per-tick total (221289), including zero limits for idle stages; wind and weather are explicitly expected inactive on the combined wind_weather path. The checker rejects stage or total overages and incomplete entries or unexpected inactivity; durations remain advisory. Revision and fixture hash remain unpinned. Representative-world capture, duration and equality qualification remains PENDING.
